In detail

The eastern coast: Quarto, Quinto and Nervi, with its cliff promenade and parks — the prettiest stretch of the city and effectively a string of seaside villages. The only entry in the Comune's 2026 plan is seasonal, reinforced summer controls at Quinto and Nervi, which is about crowding on hot nights rather than a standing problem.
